description: This C# source file defines grains for the Orleans distributed application framework, specifically implementing subscription counters with implicit stream subscriptions and logging capabilities.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain
classes.description: A grain that tracks event and error counts with implicit stream subscription capability and logging.

classes.name: FastImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain
classes.description: A specialization of ImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain with explicit stream subscription via a fast subscription.

classes.name: SlowImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain
classes.description: A variation of ImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain with a delayed activation and implicit stream subscription.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, including delayed activation for SlowImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain.

methods.name: GetErrorCounter
methods.description: Retrieves the error counter from state.

methods.name: GetEventCounter
methods.description: Retrieves the event counter from state.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles stream subscription, increasing counters upon receiving data and error events, possibly deactivating on events.

methods.name: DeactivateOnEvent
methods.description: Sets the flag to deactivate grain on receipt of an event.
